image_description: A black assault rifle (appearing to be an AR-15/M4 platform variant) lying on a yellow cloth surface. The rifle features a long barrel with a handguard, a receiver with a carry handle/optic mount, a pistol grip, and a stock. To the right of the rifle, there are disassembled components including a spring, pins, and what appears to be a bolt carrier group or similar internal parts. A blue optical sight is placed above the rifle. There is text visible on the yellow cloth packaging.

artifact_observations.location: Disassembled parts on the right side
artifact_observations.reasoning: The pile of disassembled gun parts (spring, pins, metal blocks) lacks clear mechanical logic. The spring coils merge into each other and the background, and the metal blocks have undefined edges and non-functional geometries.
The blue scope/sight has a slightly 'melted' or plastic-like texture that doesn't quite match the sharpness of the main rifle body, and its mounting interface is vague.

Structural coherence of the disassembled parts pile (spring geometry, pin shapes).
Legibility and structure of text on the yellow packaging.
Boundary sharpness between the rifle and the yellow cloth background.
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the 'disassembled parts' on the right. AI often fails to render complex mechanical assemblies like springs and bolts correctly, resulting in melted or nonsensical shapes. Also, scrutinize the text on the yellow bag; if it is gibberish, it confirms AI generation. Ensure the rifle's geometry (specifically the trigger guard and magazine release) matches real-world AR-15 patterns.
